prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit
Asset type: corrected responsive desktop-and-mobile CRM UI comp.
Primary request: Preserve the entire current composition, navy/ivory/gold identity, desktop focus-by-stage layout, phone inset, card styling and explicit mobile previous/next actions. Change only the summary metrics and funnel stage labels to match the approved Terrazza scope.
Replace the desktop summary strip with exactly these existing indicators: "Negócios ativos", "Estruturação", "Proposta", "Negociação", "Documentos e contrato", "Previsão comercial". Remove "Valor total", "Valor com previsão", "Negócios ganhos", "Taxa de conversão", and every other invented metric.
Set stage labels on desktop and mobile exactly to: "Estruturação", "Proposta", "Negociação", "Documentação", "Contrato", "Assinatura".
Each column header retains only count, total commercial value, and stalled quantity.
Keep the mobile view without drag handles and retain the explicit buttons "Voltar etapa" and "Avançar etapa".
Constraints: modify only those metric/stage texts and any spacing necessary to fit them. No conversion rate, no won-deals count, no new analytics, no drag on mobile, no watermark.
